name: What kind of warranty or guarantee do you offer on broken pipe repairs?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee do you offer on broken pipe repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind the quality of our broken pipe repairs with a satisfaction guarantee on our workmanship and parts. The specific terms of the warranty can vary depending on the type of repair performed and the materials used. We provide a detailed explanation of the applicable warranty for your specific repair, ensuring you understand the coverage for the work completed on your plumbing system.
